parts.note_add: Automatic car: the radiator carries the transmission oil-cooler hoses, which come off before the radiator (1985 FSM removal order). New factory radiators are no longer available (Atkins lists 79-82 8341-15-310 as NLA); our catalogue number N202-15-310B - check the replacement matches the automatic's cooler fittings.

Aftermarket pumps listed for this car: GMB 145-1180, Dayco DP1279, Beck/Arnley 131-1937, US Motor Works US9053. Check which catalogue item these replace: Atkins sells the pump as N232-99-153B, the successor of the cover part N232-99-153A.
Atkins' 180 F rotary thermostat 8553-15-171 lists 8553-99-152 among the numbers it replaces. Fit it with the jiggle pin at the top.
Single-wire resistive sender (YW) under the oil filter stand, grounding through its thread; M8x0.75 straight thread sealed with a crush washer.
13 psi cap. Atkins sells 8871-15-205 new (79-85 12A, not 84-85 13B); aftermarket 13 psi equivalents listed for this car include Gates 31527 and Motorad T13.
Atkins lists 8871-15-511 (79-82 12A) as out of stock; Racing Beat silicone kit 11480 (upper and lower hoses plus 4 clamps) replaces both hoses.
Atkins lists 8871-15-521 (79-82 12A) as out of stock; Racing Beat silicone kit 11480 covers it.
The bearing is pressed in by its outer race and held by a snap ring.
If the seal seat on the impeller is scored or pitted, replace the impeller along with the seal.
Sold new only in aluminium as Atkins N232-99-153B (replaces N232-99-153A and 3648-15-130), with the pump gasket; the housing-to-block gasket is separate. Cast-iron versions are no longer made.
Comes off the shaft in a press, using Mazda adapter 49 1975 145 bolted to the boss.
No longer available from Mazda. Atkins makes an aluminium reproduction (1757-15-151B-ARE).
N201-15-210B (81-83 12A) is no longer available (NLA at Atkins). The 84-85 12A clutch is N249-15-210B; no source says it interchanges.
Atkins stocks 8872-15-170A (all 81-85 12A) and says housing 1757-15-172 also fits.
Round bottle. Its successor 1052-15-350D replaces 1052-15-350B and is sold new by Atkins. Check the level with the engine cold: it should sit between the FULL and LOW marks.
Screws into the top of the radiator (M11.5x1.25, gasket 8553-15-611), which supports the parent taken. Single wire Br to the coolant level unit.
Delay unit: lights the COOLANT lamp 9-16 s after the sensor loses contact with coolant (1985 figure).

specs.note: 180 +/- 2.7 F; wax pellet type; fully open at 95 C (203 F). The 1985 manual gives 80.5-83.5 C.

specs.value: Jiggle pin positioned on the upper side
specs.note: 1985 FSM: fitted any other way, the opening temperature changes.

specs.value: Hold pressure at 75-105 kPa for about 10 s; replace if it will not reach 75 kPa (11 psi) or opens above 105 kPa (15 psi)
specs.note: Replace the cap if its rubber gasket is damaged.
Other 13 psi caps listed: SKP SK10229, CSF 4501. Calorstat RC0052 is 16 psi.

specs.value: Pump the system, warm, to 100 kPa (14 psi) and watch the gauge for about 1 minute; if it drops, inspect hoses and fittings

specs.item: Pulley ratio, eccentric shaft to pump
specs.note: V-belt drive. Feed capacity is already SP-055 (150-160 L/min at 6500 rpm, same in 1982).
0.02 in; measured with a dial indicator at the pulley, moving the pulley up and down without turning it.
13-20 ft-lb, tightened evenly in the numbered order; height-adjusting shims go on stud bolts 2 and 4.

specs.value: GMB 145-1180; Dayco DP1279; FVP US9053; Beck/Arnley 131-1937 (with gasket, metal impeller); US Motor Works US9053
specs.note: Listed for the 1982 RX-7 1.1L; check which catalogue item they replace.

specs.value: Aluminium pump with pump gasket; replaces 3648-15-130, 3648-15-130E, N232-15-130C-PT, N232-99-153, N232-99-153A
specs.note: Fits 79-85 12A and 13B. The housing-to-block gasket is not included.

specs.item: Air pump belt deflection (between air pump and water pump pulley)

specs.value: Inspect for roughness or excess end play; press in by the outer race, check it turns smoothly, refit the snap ring
Press the seal in straight with a pipe, check the lip moves smoothly, coat the lip with coolant; replace the impeller if its seal seat is scored or pitted
Engine cold: turning the fan by hand should meet resistance; no fluid leakage; bimetal not deformed; no bearing play or grease leakage
specs.note: 1985 type: thermo-modulated.
5-6 ft-lb
Unit in heated water, measured with an ohmmeter. The 1985 unit is 8569-18-510A per Atkins (fits 81-88), the same number as ours.
Under the oil filter stand; check on the car.
Mounts on top of the radiator; gasket 8553-15-611.

specs.value: Remove the sensor with the connector on, not grounded to the body, and start the engine: the lamp lights; then ground the threaded part: if the lamp stays lit the sensor is normal
specs.note: Circuit check: unplug the sensor (Br) and start the engine; the COOLANT lamp must light 9-16 s after starting.
Bench test with a 1.4 W bulb and a switch standing in for the sensor: the bulb stays off with the switch closed and lights 9-16 s after it opens.

specs.value: Engine cold: coolant near the radiator inlet port, reserve tank between the FULL and LOW marks
